title: Access Insights View for Functional Tests
description: Verify users can access the Insights view for Functional tests through the UI
testDescription: This test verifies that users can navigate to and access the Insights view specifically for Functional tests
prerequisites:
1. User has access to the application
2. Functional tests have been executed and results are available
3. Insights view for Unit, Integration and API tests are already implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Login to the application
2. Navigate to the Test Results dashboard
3. Look for 'Insights' section or tab
4. Click on 'Functional Tests' option within the Insights view
expectedResult:
1. Insights view for Functional tests is displayed
2. The view contains visualization of Functional test results
3. Navigation elements are properly rendered and accessible
testEnvironment: All supported browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
testDataRequirements: Existing Functional test results must be available in the system
comparisonPoints: Verify that the UI/UX is consistent with other test type Insights views (Unit, Integration, API)

title: Functional Test Insights Data Loading and Visualization
description: Verify that Functional test results are properly loaded and visualized in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that Functional test results data is correctly loaded, processed, and visualized in various charts and graphs in the Insights view
prerequisites:
1. Multiple Functional tests have been executed with a mix of passed, failed, and skipped tests
2. Insights view is accessible
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Observe the loading behavior of data
3. Check all visualizations including charts, graphs, and summary statistics
4. Verify that all data points match the actual test results
expectedResult:
1. Data loading animation/indicator is shown while retrieving test results
2. All charts, graphs and visualizations are properly rendered
3. Data displayed matches the actual Functional test results
4. Summary statistics accurately reflect the test execution results
5. No UI rendering issues or inconsistencies are visible
testDataValidation: Compare raw test result data with visualized data to ensure accuracy
performanceMetrics: Data should load within 5 seconds for standard test suites (up to 1000 test cases)
interactionPoints: Visualizations should be interactive (hovering, clicking should show additional information)

title: Filtering and Searching Functional Test Insights
description: Verify filter and search functionality in the Functional Test Insights view
testDescription: This test verifies that users can filter and search through Functional test results in the Insights view using various criteria
prerequisites:
1. Large set of varied Functional test results are available
2. Insights view is accessible
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Use the search field to search for specific test names or IDs
3. Apply filters for test status (pass/fail/skip)
4. Apply filters for test duration (fast/slow tests)
5. Apply filters for test categories or tags if applicable
6. Apply date range filters to see tests from specific time periods
7. Apply combinations of multiple filters together
expectedResult:
1. Search results should match the search criteria entered
2. Filter results should only show tests matching the filter criteria
3. Combined filters should work correctly (AND logic)
4. Clearing filters should restore the complete view
5. Visual indicators should show which filters are currently active
6. Results should update in real-time or with minimal delay when filters change
functionSpecificFilters: Verify that Functional test-specific attributes (like page navigation steps, browser type, screenshot availability) can be used as filter criteria
edgeCaseChecks: Test with special characters in search, extremely large result sets, and zero matching results scenarios

title: Cross-Comparison Between Test Types in Insights View
description: Verify the ability to compare Functional test results with other test types in the Insights view
testDescription: This test checks the functionality to compare metrics and results between Functional tests and other test types (Unit, Integration, API)
prerequisites:
1. Results available for all test types (Unit, Integration, API, and Functional)
2. Insights view is accessible
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Insights dashboard
2. Access the comparative view or select multiple test types for comparison
3. Select metrics to compare (success rates, duration, failure patterns)
4. Switch between different visualization types for the comparison
5. Apply filters that affect all test types being compared
expectedResult:
1. Comparison view should load and display data from all selected test types
2. Visual distinctions between different test types should be clear (using colors, patterns, or labels)
3. Metrics should be normalized where appropriate for fair comparison
4. Switching between visualization types should maintain the selected data
5. Cross-test type filters should apply correctly to all displayed data
dataAccuracyVerification: Sample specific metrics and verify they match the actual test results across different test types
consistencyRequirements: Terminology and color coding should be consistent across all test types

title: Exporting and Sharing Functional Test Insights
description: Verify the functionality to export and share Functional test insights
testDescription: This test verifies that users can export and share Functional test insights in various formats and methods
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results are available in Insights view
2. User has appropriate permissions for export functionality
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Apply desired filters and configurations to set up the view to be exported
3. Locate and click the export/share button
4. Select different export formats (PDF, CSV, PNG, etc.)
5. Try sharing options (email, link sharing, etc.) if available
6. Verify the exported content in each format
expectedResult:
1. Export options are available and functional
2. Each export format correctly captures the current view with all applied filters
3. Exported data maintains accuracy compared to the displayed data
4. Sharing options correctly generate shareable content
5. Recipients of shared content can view the intended insights without permission issues
exportFormatQuality: Check that exported visuals maintain resolution and clarity, especially in PDF and image formats
dataIntegrityCheck: Verify that exported raw data (like CSV) contains all relevant data points visible in the UI

title: Performance Testing of Functional Test Insights with Large Datasets
description: Verify the performance of Insights view when loaded with large Functional test datasets
testDescription: This test evaluates the performance characteristics of the Insights view when handling large volumes of Functional test results
prerequisites:
1. Large dataset of Functional test results (5000+ test cases) is available
2. Performance monitoring tools are configured
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view with large dataset
2. Measure initial load time
3. Perform filtering operations and measure response time
4. Perform sorting operations and measure response time
5. Navigate between different visualization types and measure transition time
6. Export large reports and measure processing time
expectedResult:
1. Initial page load should complete within acceptable thresholds (under 10 seconds)
2. UI should remain responsive during data loading (progress indicators shown)
3. Filtering operations should complete within 3 seconds
4. Sorting operations should complete within 2 seconds
5. Visualization transitions should be smooth (under 1 second)
6. No browser performance warnings or errors should appear in console
performanceThresholds: All interactions should maintain 60fps without dropped frames or visual lag
memoryUsageChecks: Browser memory consumption should not increase significantly over time (memory leak check)
optimizationVerification: Verify that pagination or virtualization is implemented for large data sets

title: Error Handling in Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify proper error handling in the Functional Test Insights view
testDescription: This test verifies that the Insights view handles various error conditions gracefully when displaying Functional test results
prerequisites: Access to test environments where error conditions can be simulated
stepsToPerform:
1. Attempt to load Insights view when no Functional test data is available
2. Simulate network interruption during data loading
3. Inject malformed or incomplete test result data
4. Simulate server errors (500, 503, etc.) during data requests
5. Simulate extremely slow server responses
6. Attempt to access insights for non-existent test runs
expectedResult:
1. User-friendly error messages should be displayed instead of technical errors
2. Retry mechanisms should be available where appropriate
3. Partial data should be handled gracefully with indicators of incompleteness
4. No unhandled exceptions should appear in the browser console
5. The UI should not freeze or become unresponsive during error conditions
6. Recovery after error resolution should work without requiring page refresh
errorMessageValidation: Error messages should be clear, actionable, and appropriate for the error condition
fallbackBehavior: Check if fallback UI or cached data is shown when new data cannot be loaded

title: Responsive Design of Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that Functional Test Insights view is properly responsive across different screen sizes
testDescription: This test ensures the Insights view for Functional tests adapts appropriately to different screen sizes and devices
prerequisites:
1. Access to devices with different screen sizes or ability to resize browser window
2. Functional test results are available
stepsToPerform:
1. Access Functional Test Insights view on a desktop browser
2. Gradually resize browser window to various widths (1920px, 1440px, 1024px, 768px, 480px)
3. Access Insights view on tablet device (or emulation)
4. Access Insights view on mobile device (or emulation)
5. Test landscape and portrait orientations on mobile/tablet
6. Check interactive elements sizing for touch targets on mobile devices
expectedResult:
1. UI should adapt fluidly to different screen sizes without horizontal scrolling
2. Charts and visualizations should resize appropriately to remain usable
3. Navigation elements should transform into mobile-friendly versions (e.g., hamburger menu)
4. Touch targets should be sufficiently sized on mobile (minimum 44x44px)
5. No content should be cut off or inaccessible at any screen size
6. Performance should remain acceptable on mobile devices
visualBreakpoints: Check specifically at standard breakpoints (576px, 768px, 992px, 1200px) for layout issues
touchInteractionVerification: Verify that touch gestures (swipe, pinch zoom) work correctly on visualizations when applicable

title: Functional Test-Specific Metrics and Visualizations
description: Verify that Insights view includes metrics and visualizations specific to Functional tests
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view includes metrics and visualizations that are particularly relevant for Functional tests beyond those used for other test types
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results with various metrics are available
2. Insights view is accessible
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Identify and check Functional test-specific visualizations
3. Verify metrics related to browser usage/compatibility
4. Check visualizations showing user flow completion rates
5. Verify metrics for page load times across tested pages
6. Check visualizations for step-by-step success rates in multi-step tests
expectedResult:
1. Functional test-specific metrics are available and accurate
2. Visualizations appropriately represent user flows and paths
3. Browser comparison data is available if multiple browsers were tested
4. Page performance metrics are available and correctly represented
5. UI interaction success/failure patterns are visualized effectively
6. Step completion metrics for multi-step tests are available
domainSpecificMetrics: Verify metrics related to DOM interactions, rendering times, and visual stability are included
comparisonWithOtherTestTypes: Identify metrics that are unique to Functional tests compared to Unit/Integration/API tests

title: Accessibility Compliance of Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that the Functional Test Insights view complies with accessibility standards
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view for Functional tests meets accessibility requirements and can be used by people with disabilities
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results are available in Insights view
2. Access to accessibility testing tools (axe, WAVE, etc.)
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Run automated accessibility analysis tools
3. Check keyboard navigation through all interactive elements
4. Verify color contrast ratios for all text and important visual elements
5. Check screen reader compatibility (using NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver)
6. Verify presence of appropriate ARIA attributes on dynamic content
7. Check that all form controls and interactive elements have proper labels
expectedResult:
1. No critical or serious accessibility violations are detected
2. All interactive elements are accessible via keyboard
3. Focus indicators are visible and clear
4. Color contrast meets WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
5. Screen readers can access and announce all important content
6. Aria-live regions are used appropriately for dynamic content updates
7. All charts and visualizations have text alternatives or descriptions
accessibilityStandards: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance should be achieved
focusManagement: Verify logical focus order and trapped focus in modals/dialogs

title: Data Accuracy Verification in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify accuracy of data represented in Functional Test Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that all data presented in the Insights view accurately reflects the actual Functional test results
prerequisites:
1. Access to raw Functional test result data
2. Insights view is accessible with data loaded
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Identify key metrics displayed (pass rate, failure count, duration averages, etc.)
3. Manually calculate these metrics from raw test results
4. Compare calculated values with those displayed in the Insights view
5. Check specific test case results against their representation in charts/graphs
6. Verify trend data accuracy over time periods
7. Check aggregated metrics for correctness
expectedResult:
1. All displayed metrics match manually calculated values
2. Individual test results are correctly represented in visualizations
3. Aggregated statistics are mathematically sound
4. Time-based trends accurately reflect historical data
5. Filtering does not introduce calculation errors
6. Edge cases (0%, 100%, N/A values) are handled correctly
dataPrecisionCheck: Verify that numerical values maintain appropriate precision without rounding errors
dataFlowVerification: Trace sample data points from source through to visualization to verify data pipeline integrity

title: Real-time Updates in Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify real-time update functionality in the Functional Test Insights view
testDescription: This test verifies that the Insights view can update in real-time or through manual refresh when new Functional test results become available
prerequisites:
1. Access to run new Functional tests while Insights view is open
2. Ability to trigger test execution or simulate new results
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Note current state of visualizations and metrics
3. Trigger new Functional test runs in another tab or window
4. Wait for automatic refresh or click manual refresh button
5. Verify that new test results appear in the Insights view
6. Check update behavior with different types of test results (pass/fail/skip)
expectedResult:
1. New test results should appear in Insights view after refresh
2. If auto-refresh is enabled, updates should occur without manual intervention
3. Visual indicators should show when data was last updated
4. Loading states should be shown during refresh operations
5. Updates should not disrupt user's current view or selections
6. Any calculations or aggregations should include the new data
refreshMechanics: Verify both manual refresh button functionality and automatic refresh timing if configured
dataConsistencyDuringUpdates: Check that partial updates don't create inconsistent or misleading visualizations

title: User Permissions and Role-Based Access for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify role-based access control for Functional Test Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that access to Functional Test Insights is properly controlled based on user roles and permissions
prerequisites:
1. Test accounts with different permission levels are available
2. Functional test results are available in the system
stepsToPerform:
1. Attempt to access Functional Test Insights with admin/full access account
2. Attempt to access with read-only user account
3. Attempt to access with no-permission user account
4. Check visibility of sensitive data with different account levels
5. Verify export/share capabilities with different account levels
expectedResult:
1. Admin users can view all Functional Test Insights data and use all features
2. Read-only users can view data but cannot modify configurations or trigger actions
3. Users without permissions should be denied access or see limited information
4. Sensitive data should only be visible to users with appropriate clearance
5. Export and sharing features should be available only to users with those permissions
permissionBoundaryTesting: Verify edge cases where permissions partially overlap functionality boundaries
unauthorizedAccessAttempts: Verify that direct URL access attempts are properly protected with authentication checks

title: Configuration and Customization of Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify configuration and customization options for Functional Test Insights view
testDescription: This test verifies that users can configure and customize the Insights view for Functional tests according to their preferences
prerequisites:
1. User with configuration permissions
2. Functional test results are available
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate and access configuration/customization options
3. Change display preferences (chart types, colors, layouts)
4. Save custom views or dashboards if supported
5. Configure default filters or time periods
6. Set up custom thresholds for metrics
7. Log out and log back in to verify persistence of settings
expectedResult:
1. Configuration options are accessible and functional
2. Visual changes apply correctly when settings are modified
3. Custom views/dashboards are saved and can be recalled
4. Default filters apply on subsequent visits
5. Custom thresholds correctly highlight metrics that cross them
6. Settings persist between sessions for the same user
7. Multiple users can have different customizations
configurationIsolation: Verify that one user's configuration changes don't affect other users
defaultReversion: Check ability to revert to default settings

title: Cross-Browser Compatibility of Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that Functional Test Insights view works correctly across different browsers
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view for Functional tests functions correctly and appears consistent across different web browsers
prerequisites:
1. Access to multiple browser types and versions
2. Functional test results are available
stepsToPerform:
1. Access Functional Test Insights view in Chrome (latest)
2. Access in Firefox (latest)
3. Access in Safari (latest)
4. Access in Edge (latest)
5. If required by specifications, test in IE11 or older browsers
6. Perform core functions in each browser (filtering, export, customization)
7. Compare visual rendering of charts and dashboard elements across browsers
expectedResult:
1. Insights view loads successfully in all required browsers
2. Visual appearance is consistent across browsers with only minor acceptable variations
3. All functionality works in all browsers with no browser-specific failures
4. Charts and visualizations render correctly in all browsers
5. Performance is acceptable across all browsers
6. No browser-specific console errors appear
crossBrowserVisualTesting: Document any acceptable visual differences between browsers
legacySupportLevel: Note specific limitations for older browsers if applicable

title: Audit Trail for Functional Test Insights View
description: Verify that all user interactions with Functional Test Insights are properly logged in the audit trail
testDescription: This test ensures that all significant user actions within the Functional Test Insights view are recorded in the system audit trail for compliance and tracking purposes
prerequisites:
1. Audit trail functionality is enabled in the system
2. User with appropriate permissions to access audit logs
3. Functional test results are available in Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Perform various actions including viewing data, filtering results, exporting reports
3. Make configuration changes to the Insights view
4. Navigate to the audit logs section of the application
5. Search for entries related to Functional Test Insights
6. Verify each action performed is recorded with appropriate details
expectedResult:
1. All significant user actions are recorded in the audit logs
2. Each log entry contains: user ID, timestamp, action type, and relevant details
3. Data exports are logged with information on what was exported
4. Configuration changes are logged with before/after values
5. Audit records are compliant with organization's retention policies
6. No sensitive data appears unmasked in the audit logs
securityCompliance: Verify that audit logs meet organizational compliance requirements for data access tracking
auditDetailLevel: Check that the granularity of audit records is sufficient for security review purposes

title: Integration with CI/CD Pipeline for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that newly completed Functional tests from CI/CD pipelines appear correctly in the Insights view
testDescription: This test verifies that Functional test results generated through automated CI/CD pipelines are properly integrated and displayed in the Insights view
prerequisites:
1. Configured CI/CD pipeline that runs Functional tests
2. Access to trigger pipeline execution
3. Access to Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Trigger a CI/CD pipeline that includes Functional tests
2. Wait for the pipeline to complete execution
3. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
4. Check if the latest test results from the pipeline are visible
5. Verify that build/pipeline metadata is correctly associated with test results
6. Compare results visible in Insights with actual pipeline outputs
expectedResult:
1. New test results from CI/CD pipeline appear in Insights view
2. Pipeline metadata (build number, branch, commit ID) is correctly associated
3. Test execution timestamp matches pipeline execution time
4. All test statuses (pass/fail/skip) match between pipeline and Insights
5. Pipeline-specific filtering options work correctly
6. Links to original CI/CD job details are functional if implemented
pipelineIntegration: Verify CI/CD system identifier is visible and can be used as a filter criterion
dataLatency: Measure and verify that pipeline results appear in Insights view within acceptable time window (typically <5 minutes)

title: Historical Trend Analysis in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that historical trend analysis for Functional tests works correctly in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view provides accurate historical trend analysis of Functional test results over time
prerequisites:
1. Historical data for Functional tests spanning at least 3 months
2. Access to Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate and select trend analysis or historical view options
3. Set different time period ranges (last week, last month, last quarter, custom range)
4. Analyze trend visualizations for various metrics (pass rate, test duration, flaky tests)
5. Compare point-in-time snapshots between different dates
6. Apply filters to focus trends on specific test categories or components
expectedResult:
1. Historical trend charts render correctly for all selected time periods
2. Data points on trend lines correspond to actual historical test results
3. Gaps in test execution (weekends, holidays) are handled appropriately
4. Statistical analysis (averages, regression lines) is calculated correctly
5. Trend visualizations adapt properly when filters are applied
6. Comparison between time periods shows accurate differential data
trendAccuracy: Verify calculations of trend slopes and regression analysis are mathematically correct
seasonalPatternDetection: Check if the system correctly identifies and visualizes recurring patterns in test results

title: Custom Dashboard Creation with Functional Test Insights
description: Verify ability to create custom dashboards incorporating Functional Test Insights widgets
testDescription: This test verifies that users can create custom dashboards that incorporate widgets from Functional Test Insights alongside other test types
prerequisites:
1. User with dashboard creation permissions
2. Functional test results available in Insights view
3. Custom dashboard functionality is implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to dashboard creation interface
2. Add widgets from Functional Test Insights (charts, metrics, status indicators)
3. Add widgets from other test types (Unit, Integration, API)
4. Arrange widgets in a custom layout
5. Configure individual widget settings and data sources
6. Save the custom dashboard
7. Share the dashboard with another user if sharing is implemented
8. Verify the dashboard loads correctly when accessed later
expectedResult:
1. Functional Test Insights widgets can be successfully added to custom dashboards
2. Widgets maintain their functionality when placed in custom dashboards
3. Mixed test type dashboards display correctly with consistent styling
4. Widget configurations are saved and applied correctly
5. Dashboard layout persists as configured
6. Shared dashboards are accessible to other users with correct permissions
7. Dashboard refreshes data appropriately when viewed
widgetInteractivity: Verify that widgets remain interactive when placed on custom dashboards
layoutResponsiveness: Check that custom dashboard layouts adapt appropriately to different screen sizes

title: Test Flakiness Detection in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that the Insights view correctly identifies and reports flaky Functional tests
testDescription: This test ensures that the Functional Test Insights view can detect, highlight, and report on flaky tests that have inconsistent pass/fail results
prerequisites:
1. Historical data with examples of flaky Functional tests
2. Access to Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate flakiness metrics or dedicated flaky test section
3. Identify tests flagged as potentially flaky
4. Check the criteria used to determine flakiness
5. View detailed history of individual flaky tests
6. Verify any recommendations or insights provided for fixing flaky tests
7. Apply filters to focus on flaky tests only
expectedResult:
1. Flaky tests are correctly identified based on inconsistent results
2. Flakiness metrics are calculated accurately (e.g., flakiness percentage)
3. Individual test flakiness history shows pattern of inconsistent results
4. Flaky tests are visually distinguished in test result listings
5. System provides useful context for troubleshooting flaky tests
6. Filtering for flaky tests returns accurate results
7. Tests that consistently pass or fail are not incorrectly flagged as flaky
flakinessCriteria: Verify the algorithm used to determine flakiness is appropriate (e.g., requires minimum number of executions)
trendAnalysis: Check if the system tracks whether flakiness is increasing or decreasing over time

title: Notifications and Alerts for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that notification and alert functionality works for Functional Test Insights
testDescription: This test verifies that users can configure and receive notifications based on Functional test results and insights
prerequisites:
1. Notification system is configured and enabled
2. User has permissions to set up alerts
3. Functional test results are available
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Access notification configuration options
3. Set up alerts for different conditions (test failure threshold, performance degradation, flaky tests)
4. Configure delivery methods (email, in-app, Slack) if multiple options exist
5. Trigger conditions that should activate notifications
6. Verify notification delivery through configured channels
7. Modify and disable notification rules
expectedResult:
1. Alert configuration options are available and functional
2. Notifications are triggered when specified conditions are met
3. Notification content is accurate and contains relevant information
4. Delivery occurs through all configured channels
5. No notifications occur when conditions aren't met
6. Modifying rules changes notification behavior appropriately
7. Disabling rules stops notifications
8. Notification history/log is available if implemented
alertPrioritization: Verify critical alerts are distinguished from informational notifications
deliveryTimeliness: Check that notifications are delivered within expected timeframes

title: Root Cause Analysis in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that root cause analysis features work correctly for failed Functional tests
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view provides useful root cause analysis for failed Functional tests to aid troubleshooting
prerequisites:
1. Failed Functional tests with error data and screenshots
2. Access to Insights view
3. Root cause analysis feature is implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate and select failed test cases
3. Access root cause analysis features
4. Review automatically identified failure patterns
5. Check correlation between similar failures
6. Verify access to failure artifacts (screenshots, logs, stack traces)
7. Review any AI/ML-based suggestions for fixing issues if implemented
expectedResult:
1. Root cause analysis tools are accessible for failed tests
2. Common failure patterns are correctly identified and grouped
3. Related failures are linked or clustered appropriately
4. All relevant failure artifacts are accessible from analysis view
5. Error messages and stack traces are properly parsed and presented
6. Screenshots at failure point are available and viewable
7. System provides useful insights beyond raw error data
errorPatternRecognition: Verify that similar errors across different tests are properly correlated
troubleshootingEfficiency: Assess whether the root cause analysis actually speeds up troubleshooting process

title: Regression Analysis for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify regression analysis functionality for detecting newly failing Functional tests
testDescription: This test verifies that the Insights view can effectively identify regression issues where previously passing Functional tests have started failing
prerequisites:
1. Historical test data showing both passing and failing results for the same tests
2. Access to Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate regression analysis section or enable regression view
3. Identify tests flagged as regressions (previously passing, now failing)
4. Review regression detection timeframe settings
5. Check details of when tests started failing
6. Correlate regressions with code changes if such feature exists
7. Verify regression notifications if implemented
expectedResult:
1. Regression analysis correctly identifies tests that changed from pass to fail
2. Regression detection timeframe is configurable or reasonable by default
3. Regression count and metrics are calculated correctly
4. Historical view shows when tests started failing
5. If implemented, system correlates regressions with code changes or deployments
6. Regression severity is indicated based on impact or frequency
7. False positives are minimized (tests that are expected to change status)
regressionTimeline: Verify accuracy of the timeframe identified for when regression occurred
impactAssessment: Check that regression analysis includes assessment of the impact of failing tests

title: Test Duration Analysis in Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that test duration analysis for Functional tests is accurate in the Insights view
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view accurately tracks, analyzes, and reports on Functional test execution duration
prerequisites:
1. Functional test results with varied execution times
2. Access to Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate test duration metrics and visualizations
3. Identify longest-running tests
4. Review duration trends over time
5. Analyze duration distribution across test categories
6. Compare duration changes between test runs
7. Check for duration anomaly detection if implemented
expectedResult:
1. Test durations are displayed accurately matching actual execution times
2. Slow tests are correctly identified based on appropriate thresholds
3. Duration trends show correct pattern of execution time changes
4. Statistical analysis of durations (average, median, percentiles) is accurate
5. Duration comparisons between test runs show correct differentials
6. If implemented, anomalous duration changes are flagged appropriately
7. Duration data can be sorted and filtered correctly
performanceBenchmarking: Verify system establishes reasonable benchmarks for expected test durations
outlierDetection: Check that statistical outliers in test duration are appropriately identified

title: Integration with Test Case Management for Functional Test Insights
description: Verify that Functional Test Insights properly integrates with test case management system
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view connects with test case management systems to provide additional context for Functional test results
prerequisites:
1. Functional tests linked to test cases in a test management system
2. Access to Insights view
3. Access to test case management system
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Select tests with associated test cases
3. Verify test case references and IDs are displayed
4. Access test case details from Insights view if implemented
5. Check bi-directional navigation between systems
6. Verify any status synchronization between systems
7. Check that test case metadata enhances Insights view
expectedResult:
1. Test case IDs and references are correctly displayed with test results
2. Links to test cases in the management system are functional
3. Test case metadata (priority, component, requirements) is visible in Insights
4. If implemented, navigation from test case system to specific insights is functional
5. Any status synchronization between systems is accurate
6. Test case coverage metrics are correctly calculated
7. Filtering by test case attributes works correctly
dataSynchronization: Verify timely synchronization between test case updates and insights display
requirementTraceability: Check that requirement coverage can be analyzed if tests are linked to requirements

title: Browser-Specific Insights for Functional Tests
description: Verify that Functional Test Insights provides browser-specific analysis when tests run across multiple browsers
testDescription: This test ensures that the Insights view provides comparative analysis for Functional tests executed across different browsers
prerequisites:
1. Functional tests executed across multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
2. Access to Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to Functional Test Insights view
2. Locate browser comparison visualizations
3. Analyze test results filtered by browser type
4. Identify browser-specific failures
5. Compare performance metrics across browsers
6. Check browser-specific screenshots for failed tests
7. Review browser version information
